Based on my research of the project's history, I found the answer to your question.

In the proposal for brokers and observer controllers to skip storage formatting before startup, a new `ClusterIdRecord` metadata record was introduced to persist the cluster ID. According to the implementation in PR KAFKA-21632 (which was part of this proposal work), the `clusterId` field in the `ClusterIdRecord` is defined as type **UUID**.
